mapper.select: SELECT ct.merchant_id AS merchantId, ct.type AS couponType, CASE WHEN ct.merchant_id = 0 THEN 'PLATFORM' ELSE 'SELF' END AS couponSource, COUNT(*) AS issuedCount, 0 AS usedCount, 0 AS discountAmount FROM user_coupons uc INNER JOIN coupon_templates ct ON uc.template_id = ct.id WHERE DATE(uc.created_time) = #{statDate} AND uc.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ct.merchant_id, ct.type

SELECT crl.merchant_id AS merchantId, ct.type AS couponType, CASE WHEN ct.merchant_id = 0 THEN 'PLATFORM' ELSE 'SELF' END AS couponSource, 0 AS issuedCount, COUNT(*) AS usedCount, SUM(crl.redeem_amount) AS discountAmount FROM coupon_redeem_logs crl INNER JOIN coupon_templates ct ON crl.template_id = ct.id WHERE DATE(crl.redeem_time) = #{statDate} AND crl.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY crl.merchant_id, ct.type, ct.merchant_id

SELECT pf.owner_id AS merchantId, pf.change_type AS sourceType, SUM(CASE WHEN pf.change_points > 0 THEN pf.change_points ELSE 0 END) AS earnedPoints, SUM(CASE WHEN pf.change_points < 0 THEN ABS(pf.change_points) ELSE 0 END) AS consumedPoints, SUM(CASE WHEN pf.change_type = 'EXPIRED_DEDUCT' THEN ABS(pf.change_points) ELSE 0 END) AS expiredPoints FROM points_flow pf WHERE DATE(pf.created_time) = #{statDate} AND pf.owner_type = 'MERCHANT' AND pf.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY pf.owner_id, pf.change_type

SELECT jml.plan_id AS planId, jmp.merchant_id AS merchantId, CASE WHEN jmp.role = 'INITIATOR' THEN 'INITIATOR' ELSE 'PARTICIPANT' END AS roleType, COUNT(*) AS triggerCount, SUM(COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(jml.rewards_snapshot), 0)) AS couponIssued, 0 AS shareAmount FROM joint_marketing_log jml INNER JOIN joint_marketing_participant jmp ON jml.plan_id = jmp.plan_id WHERE DATE(jml.created_time) = #{statDate} AND jml.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY jml.plan_id, jmp.merchant_id, jmp.role

SELECT racl.agent_user_id AS agentId, a.name AS agentName, a.responsible_region_code AS regionCode, SUM(racl.commission_amount) AS totalCommission, SUM(CASE WHEN racl.status = 'PAID' THEN racl.commission_amount ELSE 0 END) AS settledAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN racl.status IN ('ESTIMATED', 'CONFIRMED') THEN racl.commission_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pendingAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT racl.order_id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT racl.store_id) AS merchantCount, 0 AS withdrawnAmount FROM regional_agent_commission_logs racl LEFT JOIN agents a ON racl.agent_user_id = a.id WHERE DATE(racl.created_time) = #{statDate} AND racl.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY racl.agent_user_id, a.name, a.responsible_region_code

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.final_paid_price), 0) AS totalGmv, COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.merchant_id) AS activeMerchants, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS activeUsers, COALESCE(SUM(o.final_paid_price * 0.05), 0) AS commissionIncome FROM orders o WHERE DATE(o.created_time) = #{statDate} AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_deleted = 0

SELECT CURDATE() AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(o.final_paid_price), 0) AS todayGmv, COUNT(*) AS todayOrders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.merchant_id) AS todayActiveMerchants, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS todayActiveUsers, NULL AS gmvChangeRate, NULL AS ordersChangeRate, NULL AS merchantsChangeRate, NULL AS usersChangeRate, NULL AS gmvTrend, NULL AS ordersTrend, NULL AS merchantsTrend, NULL AS usersTrend FROM orders o WHERE DATE(o.created_time) = CURDATE() AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND TIME(o.created_time) <= CURTIME()

SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(o.final_paid_price), 0) AS todayGmv, COUNT(*) AS todayOrders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.merchant_id) AS todayActiveMerchants, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS todayActiveUsers, NULL AS gmvChangeRate, NULL AS ordersChangeRate, NULL AS merchantsChangeRate, NULL AS usersChangeRate, NULL AS gmvTrend, NULL AS ordersTrend, NULL AS merchantsTrend, NULL AS usersTrend FROM orders o WHERE DATE(o.created_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'COMPLETED') AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND TIME(o.created_time) <= CURTIME()

SELECT r.stat_date AS statDate, r.store_id AS storeId, r.store_name AS storeName, r.paid_order_count AS orderCount, r.real_pay_amount AS gmv, r.avg_order_value AS avgOrderValue,
CASE WHEN rw.paid_order_count IS NOT NULL AND rw.paid_order_count > 0 THEN ROUND((r.paid_order_count - rw.paid_order_count) / rw.paid_order_count * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS orderCountWow, CASE WHEN rw.real_pay_amount IS NOT NULL AND rw.real_pay_amount > 0 THEN ROUND((r.real_pay_amount - rw.real_pay_amount) / rw.real_pay_amount * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS gmvWow, CASE WHEN rw.avg_order_value IS NOT NULL AND rw.avg_order_value > 0 THEN ROUND((r.avg_order_value - rw.avg_order_value) / rw.avg_order_value * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS avgOrderValueWow,
CASE WHEN rm.paid_order_count IS NOT NULL AND rm.paid_order_count > 0 THEN ROUND((r.paid_order_count - rm.paid_order_count) / rm.paid_order_count * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS orderCountMom, CASE WHEN rm.real_pay_amount IS NOT NULL AND rm.real_pay_amount > 0 THEN ROUND((r.real_pay_amount - rm.real_pay_amount) / rm.real_pay_amount * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS gmvMom, CASE WHEN rm.avg_order_value IS NOT NULL AND rm.avg_order_value > 0 THEN ROUND((r.avg_order_value - rm.avg_order_value) / rm.avg_order_value * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS avgOrderValueMom,
CASE WHEN rw.real_pay_amount IS NULL THEN 'FLAT' WHEN r.real_pay_amount > rw.real_pay_amount THEN 'UP' WHEN r.real_pay_amount < rw.real_pay_amount THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'FLAT' END AS gmvTrend FROM report_store_daily_stats r LEFT JOIN report_store_daily_stats rw ON r.store_id = rw.store_id AND rw.stat_date = DATE_SUB(r.stat_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY) LEFT JOIN report_store_daily_stats rm ON r.store_id = rm.store_id AND rm.stat_date = DATE_SUB(r.stat_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) WHERE r.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.is_deleted = 0
AND r.store_id = #{storeId}
AND r.merchant_id = #{merchantId}
ORDER BY r.stat_date DESC, r.store_id

SELECT p.stat_date AS date, COALESCE(p.total_gmv, 0) AS value FROM report_platform_overview p WHERE p.stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND p.stat_date < CURDATE() AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.stat_date ASC

SELECT p.stat_date AS date, COALESCE(p.total_orders, 0) AS value FROM report_platform_overview p WHERE p.stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND p.stat_date < CURDATE() AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.stat_date ASC

SELECT p.stat_date AS date, COALESCE(p.active_merchants, 0) AS value FROM report_platform_overview p WHERE p.stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND p.stat_date < CURDATE() AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.stat_date ASC

SELECT p.stat_date AS date, COALESCE(p.active_users, 0) AS value FROM report_platform_overview p WHERE p.stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND p.stat_date < CURDATE() AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.stat_date ASC
